The cast fails on the epoch string, and any retried rows would double-count once the cast is fixed, so silver needs both timestamp normalisation and dedup on txn_id.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH src AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts_parsed FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts_parsed AS txn_ts, CAST(ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM src QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) = 1;"}}
